name: SET domain containing 6, protein lysine methyltransferase

function.text: SETD6 encodes n-lysine methyltransferase SETD6. Annotated molecular activities include histone methyltransferase activity and protein-lysine N-methyltransferase activity. It participates in peptidyl-lysine monomethylation and stem cell differentiation.
